name: Architecture · messy landscape
purpose: A current-state quote-to-cash landscape: a value-chain stage strip over a deliberately tangled map of mixed-size systems joined by API, batch, manual and spreadsheet connectors, with Magenta pain markers, a connection-type legend and an outcome band. Pair it with a clean target architecture on the next slide.
